# The HR Stack Guide

> Independent buyer's guide, software comparisons, and directory for modern HR technology.

## Core Directories
- [/applicant-tracking-systems/](https://www.thehrstackguide.com/applicant-tracking-systems/): Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) software comparison and reviews.
- [/global-payroll-eor/](https://www.thehrstackguide.com/global-payroll-eor/): Global payroll and Employer of Record (EOR) platform evaluation.
- [/performance-management/](https://www.thehrstackguide.com/performance-management/): HR performance management and employee engagement software.

## Key Comparisons
- Head-to-head comparison pages evaluate pricing, feature matrices, integration ecosystems, and buyer checklists for HR platforms.
